title: Zheng He: seven voyages
hook: Was this one continuous trip across the ocean?

knows: Events happen in places and at different times.

objective: The growing picture combines seven voyages between 1405 and 1433.

claims.text: 1405: Departure. The first of seven voyages begins.
1405–33: Southeast Asia. The voyages connect Southeast Asian waters.
1405–33: Indian Ocean. The fleets visit Indian Ocean destinations.
By 1433: Farther west. Voyages also reach East Africa and the Red Sea.

The growing picture combines seven voyages between 1405 and 1433. It is not the track of a single ship making one enormous circuit. A network view reveals repeated maritime connections across Southeast Asia, the Indian Ocean, East Africa and the Red Sea.
Voyages are grouped by region; the sequence does not date each first regional visit.
